verdict.rationale: Qodo is a SaaS code-review platform with an MCP server and CLI, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of API versioning or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path. The changelog and migration-guide mentions are adjacent features, not a versioning or deprecation policy, so they earn no credit.
